acceptance: With the base commit available in the reviewer workspace, a `git diff` counts as a read of a file only with an explicit revision range against the base (for example `git diff <base>..HEAD -- path`), and `git show <base>:path` is not counted as a read of the head file. A bare `git diff -- path` on the clean head checkout and `git show HEAD -- path` do not count.
Count, quiet and file-name-only flags (`grep -l`, `grep -c`, `rg -q`), and zero-length head/tail (`head -n 0`), do not count
Each excluded form is a test case in tests/unit/scripts/oracle_reviewers/test_evidence.py
context: 2026-10-09 tracker review: priority lowered from medium to low. The loopholes are real (a bare `git diff` on a clean head checkout, `grep -l/-c`, `rg -q`), but the hollow reviews observed so far had no reads at all, and the read check now catches those. The former acceptance 3 (Claude Grep and limited Reads) is dropped: the decision record (_project/decisions/oracle-review-protocol-2026-10-08.md:47) already says a Read or Grep naming the file counts, and docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md:213 repeats it. The item now needs oracle-reviewer-checkout-has-no-base-commit-20261009: base-ref commands cannot work until the reviewer workspace holds the base commit, and the base-ref rules in acceptance 1 depend on it.
description: evidence.reads_file counts any content-reading command with the file as an operand. Several of these print nothing of the head version: `git diff -- path` on the clean head checkout, `git show <base>:path`, `git show HEAD -- path`, `head -n 0`, `grep -l/-c` and `rg -q`. For Claude, a Grep naming a file, or a Read with a small limit, counts as a full read. The check is a tripwire for reviewers that read nothing, but a reviewer can satisfy it without seeing the changed code. Deferred from #2783 (Medium, and a Low in its review body).
